experimental_question: Can a local model identify a latent retry-policy regression and delayed queue amplification under an explicitly visible and fully aligned evaluation contract?

construct_validity.intended_construct: Source-grounded diagnosis of delayed nonlinear failure propagation across a worker and queue system.
construct_validity.v04_alignment_change: Preserve the v0.3 temporal repair while making scope comparison semantic, counter-evidence non-exhaustive and evidence roles non-duplicative.
known_blind_spots: deterministic verification does not score prose quality

reporting_limits: v0.4 is a new representation of an existing incident, not an independent task.
Do not pool v0.2, v0.3 and v0.4 attempts as repeated observations.
Normalized semantic success and strict transport compliance must remain separate.
Capability Sweep evidence does not estimate reliability or latency tails.
